approval.decision: OD-INDY-8 (kickoff release set: the newest stable, compatible, verified release of each Echelon system, approved in the Registry after Conditor qualification; if a component fails qualification, keep the newest compatible release and record the exception, VER-003), kemiller2002/indy-init docs/OWNER-DECISIONS-2026-10-24.md (indy-init#13), and EDS-ADR-002 (the Echelon brand lives in kemiller2002/echelon-design-system). On 2026-11-09 the owner answered a multiple-choice prompt, "To ship the new look I'd release Echelon theme 1.1.0 (fonts plus the approved panels, app bar, chips, emphasis buttons and loading styles) and move echelon-current to 1.39.0, with only the theme version changed. Approve that channel release?", with the option "Yes, approved (Recommended)". The exact minute is not available to the recording agent: the answer came after the owner's 20:24 local message and before the theme pull request's review began, so `at` records 20:40 local, the latest moment it could have been given, not the exact time; the offset -05:00 assumes US Eastern, the basis 1.37.2 and 1.38.0 used. The set selects exactly that move: the optional Echelon theme 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0, nothing else
approval.recordedBy: anthropic/claude-code, on the owner's explicit approval ("Yes, approved (Recommended)", 2026-11-09, releasing the Echelon theme 1.1.0 and moving echelon-current to 1.39.0 with only the theme version changed) relayed to this session by the orchestrating agent, which authorized the Conditor 0.10.25 release, this channel move to 1.39.0 and the recording of the approval; recorded after REG-RU-007 passed in CI against released Conditor 0.10.25 on this exact set and Conditor qualified it from the real release bytes (conditor#138); no VER-003 exception applies

Replaced by Forma 1.0.1 (v1.0.1, 0ddbfc96), the 1.0 major release line (forma#182) with the codemod fixes of forma#183. Breaking for every consumer: Forma is brand-neutral (BNR-001, EDS-ADR-002) and its ef- namespace is renamed forma- (FORMA-NS-001: every .ef-* class, --ef-* property, data-ef-* attribute and <ef-*> tag; data-ef-brand is data-forma-brand); dist/brands/echelon.css (export ./brands/echelon.css) and the Echelon marketing bundles forma-echelon-marketing.css and forma-marketing-theme-echelon.css are removed, and the Echelon brand is the optional echelon-theme 1.0.0 selected beside it. Applications migrate with the shipped F# codemod tools/NamespaceMigrator and, if Echelon applications, add echelon-theme; an application that has not migrated stays on 1.37.2. The profile's Forma range moves to >=1.0.0 <2.0.0 for this. License PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 (read from the published package.json). Every asset digest re-hashed from download matches GitHub's API digest; forma-all.css and forma-marketing.css match forma-marketing.sha256

Replaced by Arca 0.7.0 (v0.7.0, 7e1f90d6), a minor release (DF-ARCA-2026-0015; arca#47, arca#48) for bounded queue-sync scheduling (ARCA-OFF-010). It adds Deferral (why an attempt stopped short, typed) with SyncAttempt, OfflineSync.attempt and OfflineSync.drive; RetryPolicy (a policy that could spin is refused); SyncSchedule (pure transitions with isDue and wakeAt); and SaveState.ofQueue. OfflineSync.step and run keep their results. Fixes: a GitHub 5xx read is ARCA.GITHUB.SERVER_ERROR, transient, and a 5xx to the ref update is an unknown outcome reconciled by idempotency key; ConnectivityChanged acts only on a change. Source-compatibility caveat: the public union CallFailure (Arca.GitHub) gains the case ServerError, so an exhaustive match on it in application code needs that case; otherwise 0.6.0 code compiles and behaves as before. The persisted queue format is unchanged and the license stays PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 (all three nuspecs). The three .nupkg files match checksums.txt and GitHub's API digests, and each verifies with gh attestation verify (release.yml on main at 7e1f90d6). Package dependencies are unchanged from 0.6.0: EchelonFoundry.Arca.Limen 0.7.0 needs EchelonFoundry.Limen.Store and .Contract >= 0.9.0 (limen-fsharp 0.9.0 selected), and Arca.GitHub needs Aegis.Core and Aegis.Integration.GitHub >= 1.0.0 (aegis 1.0.0 selected); EchelonFoundry.Fides.Arca 0.2.0 needs Arca.Core >= 0.1.0. Conditor has no Arca descriptor: released Conditor 0.10.18 accepts it as an unlisted nuget-library and installs the set's selection from its release-asset NuGet feed against the Registry's sha256 (REG-RU-007, conditor#123). Known consumer incompatibility, not a VER-003 exception: Chrona declares arca 0.5.0 and does not compile against 0.6.0 or later; it stays on 1.31.0 until it migrates, and Conditor 0.10.18's CI plans Chrona's 1.33.0 moves without applying them (conditor#123). No component failed qualification
